model_name: MITRE ATT&CK Detection Coverage Analysis Model

detection_presence.description: At least one detection exists for the technique.

validated_detection.description: Validated detections increase confidence in technique coverage.

data_source_diversity.description: Independent telemetry sources improve resilience and visibility.

detection_type_diversity.description: Different detection methods reduce dependence on one analytic approach.

active_detection_bonus.description: Coverage receives additional credit when detections are active rather than experimental.

confidence_score.description: Average detection confidence contributes to overall coverage strength.

needs_review_penalty.description: Detections requiring additional review reduce effective coverage confidence.

experimental_penalty.description: Experimental detections provide less reliable operational coverage.

redundancy_analysis.description: Three or more detections mapped to the same technique should be reviewed for both resilient coverage and potential duplicate alerting.

critical_gap.condition: GAP coverage on a Critical-priority technique

high_gap.condition: GAP coverage on a High-priority technique

critical_low_coverage.condition: LOW coverage on a Critical-priority technique

moderate_gap.condition: GAP coverage on a Moderate-priority technique

recommendation_templates.STRONG: Maintain current coverage, validate periodically, and review overlapping detections for unnecessary duplicate alerting.
recommendation_templates.MODERATE: Maintain existing detections and improve coverage through additional telemetry, analytic diversity, or validation.
recommendation_templates.LOW: Prioritize tuning and validation. Add independent telemetry or detection logic before treating this technique as reliably covered.
recommendation_templates.GAP: Develop new detection capability for this technique using appropriate endpoint, identity, network, cloud, or application telemetry.

tactic_analysis.description: Tactic strength is based on the average coverage score of priority techniques assigned to that tactic.

analyst_guardrails: Do not interpret detection count alone as strong coverage.
Do not treat an unvalidated or experimental rule as equivalent to a validated production detection.
Do not assume multiple detections provide independent coverage when they rely on the same telemetry and logic.
Do not treat a MITRE ATT&CK mapping as proof that a detection reliably identifies every implementation of that technique.
Do not classify a technique as fully covered solely because one rule exists.
Review false-positive behavior and analyst workload when multiple detections overlap.
Treat the coverage model as an engineering prioritization aid rather than a universal measurement standard.
